verses.1: And the word of Jehovah was to me:
verses.2: What kind of fruit tree will Adam’s son be, compared to all the other fruit trees that grew on the trees of the garden?
verses.3: It can be used to make tools for various purposes. Or, if they want to use it as a pole for hanging things on it, then that’s also acceptable.
verses.4: Now, the fire was given to be consumed by eating its two ends. The fire was consumed, and then it became possible to complete the task.
verses.5: See, when they are still pure, nothing can be done with them for any purpose. But once they become corrupted by fire, they can still be used for other purposes.
verses.6: Therefore, this is what the Lord God said: “Just as the fig tree bears fruit in its tree, so also I will give you fruit to eat. In the same way, I will also give you the inhabitants of Jerusalem.”
verses.7: And I will put my face in them from the fire that comes out. The fire will consume them, and you shall know that I am Jehovah, who has placed my face in them.
verses.8: And I will give the land that is desolate back to its former state. May the name of the LORD God be exalted.
